name: webxr-environment-workspace
description: Workspace for the Reality Collective WebXR Environment Extensions - an engine-free core for the world around the player (sky, fog and lighting) and the sound in it, with three.js and Meta IWSDK adapters and a demo playground.

scripts.build: npm --workspace @realitycollective/webxr-environment run build && npm --workspace @realitycollective/threejs-environment run build && npm --workspace @realitycollective/iwsdk-environment run build
scripts.build:playground: npm run build && npm --workspace environment-playground run build
